interpretation: Nine JDTLS legacy cases receive command conversion errors because the harness supplied numeric direction/depth instead of the editor client JSON-string encoding. These cases are development-only evidence, not server correctness failures.
The modern JDTLS subtype case passes. Its supertype case retains stale preparation ranges after the edit before successful retry/settled replies, and also a nonzero shutdown exit.
JVMD explicitly declares all eleven cases unsupported.
The reducer reports missing series samples after legacy early failures. This pilot is not a valid complete experiment and permits no comparative performance claim.
